workflow: Fresh ordinary scene baseline -> prepare --baseline A --terrain-id ID --catalog-probe -> execute through existing terrain queue.

catalog --run C resolves actual loaded category2 record IDs through the captured native codec table, native loaded render-style dictionary, and exact installed CHS TextMap hash matches. No label is invented.

calibrate --run C returns actual matrix, origin and grid/height basis. With --points, result.edits is ready for plan/batch-create after extracting the array; map planning remains the consumer's responsibility.

plan or batch-create --catalog-run C binds C to every write. Fresh complete cells and scene are still required. Native callback compares entire material source and world matrix before opening a transaction.
Existing execute, accept, native-save and verify-save/batch-verify-save contracts remain mandatory. Matrix/catalog drift rejects before mutation; do not replay old cards.
boundaries: No assumption that material 0 means grass
Saved/local position is not a world matrix
Integer codes only; non-grid heights reject unless nearest explicitly selected and residuals retained
No origin setter, terrain planning, game loading, desktop control or direct GIL writing
Catalog/matrix reads do not prove pixels, surface contacts or 11017-cell runtime performance
